item.title: Tessera 0.2.0-beta.9
item.description: - Changed: the ring always shows its wedge icons. Ring › Appearance › Layout icons offers Layout pictures or Arrows; "None" is gone, because it left the ring (and the Ring pane's wedge picker) blank. If you had chosen None, you'll see layout pictures again. - Changed: About's icon in Settings is pink, so it no longer looks like General's.

item.title: Tessera 0.2.0-beta.8
item.description: - Fixed: windows that sit with a gap between them (for example after macOS restores them at login) now close it the first time you drag an edge. Before, "Resize neighbours to fill the display" did nothing across a gap, and Tessera saved the gap as part of your split. - Splits already saved with a gap stay until your next adjustment, or until you forget them in Settings › Splits.

item.title: Tessera 0.2.0-beta.7
item.description: - New: the menu bar menu shows each item's hotkey at the right edge, such as ⌃⌥T for Tile All Windows and ⌃⌥Z for Undo Last Move, so you can learn them from the menu. A hotkey you change shows the next time the menu opens. - New: Settings › General › Menu bar › Show each item's shortcut (on by default) hides them.

item.title: Tessera 0.2.0-beta.6
item.description: - New: closing a window no longer leaves a gap. When a window that sits side by side with others closes (or its app quits), the rest cover its space straight away: the apps left go back to the split you taught Tessera for them, or, without one, the window beside the space you used last grows into it. A column beside a closed column widens together. ⌃⌥Z puts the windows back. - New: Settings › Splits › Fill the space when a window closes (on by default) turns it off. - New: setup has a "Tiling that remembers" step, and a tip explains the first gap Tessera fills.

item.title: Tessera 0.2.0-beta.5
item.description: - New: What Just Happened? Press ⌃⌥/ (or choose What Just Happened? in the menu bar) and a card explains Tessera's last move: which windows it tiled, whether it used your learned split, and what to press to change it. ‹ and › step through the last 10 events. From the command line: `tessera explain`. - New: tips that appear on their own. The first time you tile, and when Tessera does something you might not expect (such as tiling with a split you taught it), a card points at the windows and explains what happened. The first Tile card can walk you through dragging an edge: the neighbours follow, Tessera saves the split, and Undo puts the old split back. - New: buttons on the card for Tile Evenly Instead, Forget This Split and Undo. - Turn tips off, or stop the screen dimming behind them, in Settings › General › Help.

item.title: Tessera 0.2.0-beta.4
item.description: - Fixed: neighbours now fill the space without a Tile first. Snap windows side by side any way you like (Ring, shortcuts, menu) and resizing one makes the windows beside it follow, from launch onwards. It keeps working after Undo, a display change, sleep and wake, and Tile Evenly. Tile Evenly still never overwrites your learned split.

item.title: Tessera 0.2.0-beta.3
item.description: - New: neighbours fill the space. After a Tile, resize or move one window and the windows beside it follow its new edges, so no part of the display is left empty. The new arrangement is remembered as your split. Turn it off in Settings › Splits › "Resize neighbours to fill the display". - Fixed: one ⌃⌥Z after a Tile now undoes only the Tile's own moves, and every window undoes in the order it moved, even if you moved a window with a shortcut while the Tile was still gliding.

item.title: Tessera 0.2.0-beta.2
item.description: - New: Tile Evenly. Tiles every window on a display in equal shares, ignoring your learned split without forgetting it. Find it in the menu bar under Snap, in Shortcuts, App Intents, AppleScript, `tessera tile evenly` and `tessera://tile/evenly`.

item.title: Tessera 0.2.0-beta.1
item.description:
## Tessera 0.2.0 beta 1
The first beta delivered through Tessera's built-in updater.
**New**
- **Check for Updates.** It's in About, the menu bar menu and General → Updates. Tessera checks on the schedule you choose (daily, weekly, fortnightly or monthly), shows these notes, and installs only updates signed with Tessera's key. Turn on "Include beta versions" to receive betas like this one. - **Update cue.** When an automatic check finds an update, a dot appears on the menu bar icon and the menu item reads "Update Available…". - **Learned splits.** After Tile or Remember Split, Tessera learns how you adjust a display's windows and reuses those sizes next time. Manage them in Settings → Splits. - **Icon-only Ring**, with an action caption and shortcut receipts.
**Changed**
- About has its own pane (⌘0).
This beta isn't notarised. On a Mac that hasn't run Tessera before, Control-click the app and choose Open the first time.
